title: First release
short: Deep Forge opens its gate: this is the first public version.
Dig, smelt, forge, trade and explore with your own dwarf hold.
New players get a short list of first steps.

details.head: Your hold
items: A fortress cut into a mountain: dig rock, place rooms, hallways and stairwells where you like.
Dwarves mine ore, smelt bars, mix alloys and forge goods, also while you are away.
Workshops grow with machines; the forge, the bellows and other rooms have small games for better results.
Gems, sockets and magic for tools and weapons.

details.head: The world
items: A shared market with prices that move, caravans to the cities and a trade depot with rules and buy orders.
Expeditions with decisions and loot, monsters in the deep and raids at the gate.

details.head: New in this version
items: First steps: a short checklist in the Hold tab shows new players what to do. You can skip it.
Account: change your password or delete your account under More.
New pixel fonts for headings and paper.
